regions.name: Mekong
regions.quote: Recorded from numerous tributary drainages of the Mekong River in Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia, including the Khone Falls area.

regions.name: Annamite Mountains
regions.quote: In Vietnam it is also known from coastal rivers draining the eastern Annamite Mountains, which are not connected to the Mekong.

regions.name: Duc My River
regions.quote: A typical habitat is the Duc My River in central Vietnam, where the fish were studied in a gently sloping section around 25 m wide characterised by a series of rocky riffles, rapids and deeper pools with a mixed sand and gravel substrate.

regions.name: Dong Nai River
regions.quote: In the Dong Nai River, southern Vietnam sympatric species included Garra cambodgiensis, Mystacoleucus obtusirostris, Barbodes rhombeus, Rasbora paviana, Hemimyzon papilio, Homalopteroides smithi, Misgurnus anguillicaudatus, and Glyptothorax laosensis.
